_comment: workspace-os guardrail rules for THIS repo. Copy to .claude/guardrails.json and edit. The engine reads only `bash` and `write`; `ip_class` and any `_`-prefixed key are informational. deny -> blocks the tool call; warn -> advisory message. Built-in warn-only defaults (secrets, force-push, rm -rf) always run regardless of this file. A rule may add a `predicate` (shell): it fires only when its regex matches AND the predicate exits 0, run in the call's cwd under a 5s timeout - so this file executes shell on matching tool calls and is part of the repo's trusted configuration, like repo-level hooks.

bash.name: no-raw-duckdb
bash.reason: Use mcp__duckdb__query, not a raw DuckDB connection.

bash.name: no-writes-on-main
bash.reason: checkout is on main; switch to a feature branch first.

write.name: employer-tripwire
write.reason: clean-room repo: this write matches an employer tripwire string.
